tools.name: evenium_list_events
tools.description: List the events of the Evenium account, with id, title, dates, status and creation date. Filter by title (partial match), status and start/end/creation dates. Use an event id with the guest and session tools. GET /events.

tools.name: evenium_get_event
tools.description: One event by id: title, description, dates, status, site path and its fields (type, your external id, ...). GET /events/{eventId}.

tools.name: evenium_list_guests
tools.description: List the guests (invited contacts) of an event with name, email, company, registration status (e.g. CONFIRMED, DECLINED, UNANSWERED), category and fields. Filter by status, name, email, company or last update. GET /events/{eventId}/guests.

tools.name: evenium_get_guest
tools.description: One guest of an event, by contact id or by guest code: name, email, status, category and fields (event-only fields flagged). Optionally include REGISTRATION (registrations to sessions), PRESENCE and SIGNATURE data. GET /events/{eventId}/guests/{contactId} or /guests/guestCode/{guestCode}.

tools.name: evenium_get_guest_status
tools.description: The registration status of one guest at an event (e.g. CONFIRMED, DECLINED, CANCELED). GET /events/{eventId}/guests/{contactId}/status.

tools.name: evenium_get_guest_post_status
tools.description: The attendance (post) status of one guest after the event: UNKNOWN, NO_SHOW or PRESENT. GET /events/{eventId}/guests/{contactId}/postStatus.

tools.name: evenium_get_guest_accommodations
tools.description: The hotel room bookings of one guest at an event: room id, check-in and check-out dates, status. Not available on the evenium.net platform. GET /events/{eventId}/guests/{contactId}/accommodations.

tools.name: evenium_list_hotels
tools.description: The hotels of an event with name, group, stars, contact details and, if asked, full location and rooms. Not available on the evenium.net platform. GET /events/{eventId}/hotels.

tools.name: evenium_create_guest
tools.description: WRITE: invite a person to an event. Either invite an existing contact (contact_id) or create a guest from scratch (first_name, last_name, email, ...), which may also create a new contact. The optional status sets the registration status (the invitation emails of the event may follow Evenium's own ru

tools.name: evenium_update_guest_status
tools.description: WRITE: set the registration status of a guest at an event (e.g. CONFIRMED, DECLINED, CANCELED). Can trigger Evenium's own workflows for that status. Read the current value first with evenium_get_guest_status. PUT /events/{eventId}/guests/{contactId}/status.

tools.name: evenium_update_guest_post_status
tools.description: WRITE: set the attendance (post) status of a guest: PRESENT, NO_SHOW or UNKNOWN (for example after check-in). PUT /events/{eventId}/guests/{contactId}/postStatus.

tools.name: evenium_list_contacts
tools.description: List the contacts of the address book (id, your custom id, name, email, company and fields). Filter by name, email, company or last update. GET /contacts.

tools.name: evenium_get_contact
tools.description: One contact by Evenium id or `ext:<customId>`: name, gender, email, company and fields. GET /contacts/{contactId}.

tools.name: evenium_get_contact_events
tools.description: The events a contact is invited to, with the contact's registration (status, post status, category) in each. Filter by event start, end or creation date. GET /contacts/{contactId}/events.

tools.name: evenium_create_contact
tools.description: WRITE: add a contact to the address book (name, email, company, optional custom id and fields). Does not invite them to an event (use evenium_create_guest). May create a duplicate of an existing person: search with evenium_list_contacts first. POST /contacts.

tools.name: evenium_update_contact
tools.description: WRITE: change a contact's email, company or fields (only what you pass is sent). The change applies to the contact everywhere, including its guest records. PUT /contacts/{contactId}.

tools.name: evenium_list_event_parts
tools.description: List the event parts (sessions, workshops, activities) of an event with title, dates, nature, code and location. Filter by title and start/end/update dates. GET /events/{eventId}/eventParts.

tools.name: evenium_get_event_part
tools.description: One event part (session) by id: title, dates, nature, code, location and fields. GET /events/{eventId}/eventParts/{eventPartId}.

tools.name: evenium_list_event_part_registrations
tools.description: The registrations to one session: contact id, status, attendance, category and dates. With include_deleted, deleted registrations are returned too (status DELETED). GET /events/{eventId}/eventParts/{eventPartId}/registrations.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: evenium_list_guests, evenium_get_guest, evenium_get_guest_post_status, evenium_update_guest_post_status, evenium_list_contacts, evenium_get_contact, evenium_get_contact_events, evenium_create_contact · Private data: evenium_list_guests, evenium_get_guest, evenium_list_hotels, evenium_create_guest, evenium_list_contacts, evenium_get_contact, evenium_get_contact_events, evenium_create_contact, evenium_update_contact, evenium_list_event_part_registrations · Public sink: evenium_list_guests, evenium_get_guest, evenium_get_guest_post_status, evenium_create_guest, evenium_update_guest_post_status, evenium_list_contacts, evenium_get_contact, evenium_get_contact_events, evenium_create_contact, evenium_update_contact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: evenium_list_guests, evenium_get_guest, evenium_get_guest_post_status, evenium_update_guest_post_status, evenium_list_contacts, evenium_get_contact, evenium_get_contact_events, evenium_create_contact · Private data: evenium_list_guests, evenium_get_guest, evenium_list_hotels, evenium_create_guest, evenium_list_contacts, evenium_get_contact, evenium_get_contact_events, evenium_create_contact, evenium_update_contact, evenium_list_event_part_registrations · Public sink: evenium_list_guests, evenium_get_guest, evenium_get_guest_post_status, evenium_create_guest, evenium_update_guest_post_status, evenium_list_contacts, evenium_get_contact, evenium_get_contact_events, evenium_create_contact, evenium_update_contact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
